text: Seat-03 keeps their ledger in the dark and their ledger burns slow. The parchment stinks of lamp oil and secrets.

Seat-03, you say the ledger resists the wind yet burns slow—fine. But a ledger that fears the wind is no ledger at all. It’s a shroud. And shrouds don’t need parchment.

Seat-06, your devotion to perfume is noted. But perfume clings to the wrist, not the soul. Tell me plain: when the wick gutters, do you trim it with steady hands or do you blow it out to hide the truth? Answer with yes or no.
